# Coefficients
```{r}
#| code-fold: true
# create first set of fourier coefficients
generate_fourier_coef <- function(nb, sd0 = 2, p=2.5) {
  K <- (nb - 1) / 2
  k <- rep(1:K, each = 2) #coefficient index vector
  sd_k <- sd0 / (k^p) 
  rnorm(2 * K, mean = 0, sd = sd_k)
}
##### SPHERE TO ELLIPSE TRANSFORM METHOD #######
generate_coef_pair <- function(nb, sd0 = 2, d = 1, p = 2.5, seed = NULL) {
  
  if (!is.null(seed)) set.seed(seed)
  
  coef1 <- generate_fourier_coef(nb, sd0, p)
  
  # uniform sphere direction
  z <- rnorm(length(coef1))
  u <- z / sqrt(sum(z^2))  # unit length
  
  # ellipsoid axes (impose similar decay structure)
  axes <- 1 / (1:length(coef1))^p
  
  # scale to ellipse
  dir <- u * axes
  
  # renormalize
  dir <- dir / sqrt(sum(dir^2))
  
  # shift by d
  coef2 <- coef1 + d * dir
  
  list(coef1 = coef1, coef2 = coef2)
}
#### Test Euclidean Distance ####
coefs <- generate_coef_pair(25, d=2)
# sqrt(sum((coefs$coef2 - coefs$coef1)^2))
#### Plot Series Against Each Other ####
coefs <- generate_coef_pair(nb = 25, d = 1)
coef1 <- coefs$coef1
coef2 <- coefs$coef2
fb <- create.fourier.basis(rangeval = c(0, 500), nbasis = 25, period = 500)
Phi <- eval.basis(1:500, fb)[, -1]
x1 <- as.numeric(Phi %*% coef1)
x2 <- as.numeric(Phi %*% coef2)
# plot(x1, type = 'l')
# plot(x2, type = 'l')
# x.state <- (eval.basis(1:n, basisobj = fb)[, -1] %*% fb.coef) |> scale()
x.state <- x1
n <- length(x.state)
```

# Setting window length and High/Low SNR values

```{r}
# fix S2_y to make it mean of sd of x.state over a rolling time window
window_frac <- 0.1   # proportion of length
window_min  <- 10 
window <- max(window_min, round(window_frac * n))
lambda_low  <- 0.5  
lambda_high <- 2 
```

# Function

```{r}
# first getting the local rolling variance of x.state for checks and s2_y_obs
loc_var <- roll_var(x.state, width = window, center = TRUE, min_obs = 2)
s2_y_obs <- mean(loc_var, na.rm = TRUE)

# function for generating noise
simulate_arma_noise <- function(x.state, window, s2_y_obs,
                                ar.coefs, ma.coefs,
                                lambda_target,
                                n_start = 100,
                                ma_lag_max = 200,
                                name = NULL) {
  n <- length(x.state)
  # Theoretical autocorrelation up to window-1
  rho <- ARMAacf(ar = ar.coefs, ma = ma.coefs, lag.max = (window - 1))
  # Convert to infinite MA to compute stationary variance (unit innovation variance)
  psi <- ARMAtoMA(ar = ar.coefs, ma = ma.coefs, lag.max = ma_lag_max)
  psi_full <- c(1, psi)
  #Var(noise) when innovation variance sigma^2 = 1
  gamma0_unit <- sum(psi_full^2)  
  gamma_unit  <- gamma0_unit * rho # gamma(k) when sigma^2 = 1
  #Variance of window mean when sigma^2 = 1
  k <- 1:(window - 1)
  sigma2_window_mean_unit <- (1 / window^2) * (
    window * gamma_unit[1] + 2 * sum((window - k) * gamma_unit[k + 1]))
  #Choose sigma2 so that window-mean SNR matches lambda_target
  sigma2 <- s2_y_obs / (lambda_target * sigma2_window_mean_unit)
  sigma  <- sqrt(sigma2)
  #Simulate ARMA noise
  noise <- arima.sim(
    model = list(order = c(length(ar.coefs), 0, length(ma.coefs)),
                 ar = ar.coefs, ma = ma.coefs),
    n = n,
    rand.gen = function(t) rnorm(t, mean = 0, sd = sigma),
    n.start = n_start)
  
  #Observed series
  y <- x.state + noise
  
  # checks
  loc_var_signal <- roll_var(x.state, width = window, center = TRUE, min_obs = 2)
  loc_var_noise  <- roll_var(noise,   width = window, center = TRUE, min_obs = 2)
  # Checking to make sure not na and denominator is not non-zero
  valid <- !is.na(loc_var_signal) & !is.na(loc_var_noise) & loc_var_noise > 1e-5
  snr_local_vec <- loc_var_signal[valid] / loc_var_noise[valid]
  #plots
    plot(0:(window - 1), rho, type = "h",
         main = paste0(name, " ACF"),
         xlab = "Lag", ylab = "ACF")
    abline(h = 0)
    # Signal + noisy signal
    plot(x.state, type = "l",
         main = paste0(name, " | lambda=", lambda_target),
         xlab = "t", ylab = "value")
    lines(y)

  list(
    name = name,
    lambda_target = lambda_target,
    ar = ar.coefs,
    ma = ma.coefs,
    sigma = sigma,
    sigma2 = sigma2,
    rho = rho,
    noise = noise,
    y = y,
    # theory helpers
    gamma0_unit = gamma0_unit,
    sigma2_window_mean_unit = sigma2_window_mean_unit, 
    #checks
    snr_local_vec = snr_local_vec, 
    loc_var_noise = loc_var_noise, 
    loc_var_signal = loc_var_signal
  )
}
```

# MA 1 

```{r}
ar.coefs <- numeric(0)
ma.coefs <- c(0.3)

ma1_low <- simulate_arma_noise(
  x.state = x.state, window = window, s2_y_obs = s2_y_obs,
  ar.coefs = ar.coefs, ma.coefs = ma.coefs,
  lambda_target = lambda_low,
  name = "MA1 | low"
)
ma1_high <- simulate_arma_noise(
  x.state = x.state, window = window, s2_y_obs = s2_y_obs,
  ar.coefs = ar.coefs, ma.coefs = ma.coefs,
  lambda_target = lambda_high,
  name = "MA1 | high"
)
```

# ARMA 21 

```{r}
ar.coefs <- c(0.8, 0.1)

arma21_low <- simulate_arma_noise(

  ar.coefs = ar.coefs, ma.coefs = ma.coefs,

)

arma21_high <- simulate_arma_noise(

)
```
